IC2: - Former professional football play from 1960 to present.
IC3: - Prior completed the first Health and Wellness Questionnaire (Q1)
IC4: - "Healthy" subjects: ability to give informed consent, comply with study procedures, and have a Telephone-Montreal Cognitive Assessment (T-MoCA) score of >20.
IC5: - "Afflicted" participants: must meet criteria for at least one of the following subjective afflictions based on Q1 responses: 1) Cardiovascular Dysfunction, 2) Neurocognitive Disease, 3) Chronic Pain, and/or 4) Sleep Apnea
IC6: - "Afflicted" participants must be able to give informed consent or have a legal guardian present to provide informed consent (if participants demonstrate on T-MoCA score <19) and to comply with study procedures.
